capabilities: Collect open todos from vault-wide or filtered scopes into a side panel
Check off todos in the panel and update the source file
Drag and drop todos to reorder them or move them between notes
Filter todos by note scope, date notes, and exclusion rules
Roll over open todos from past daily notes into today's note
disambiguation: Not a single-note checklist maker; it aggregates unchecked todos from across the vault into one panel.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian scatters unchecked todos across many notes, with no single panel to see and act on them all at once.
summary: Side-panel checklist that gathers unchecked todos from all Markdown files in the vault to check off, reorder, filter and jump to.
